//: A project owns the files under its root. Files that must stay where consumers or tools find them (the crate's Cargo.toml and tests/, the composite actions, the Dockerfile, demo/) are attached to their project through `{workspaceRoot}/...` inputs instead, which is also how Nx's affected detection maps a change to them onto that project.

boundaries.//: Which project types may depend on which, by tag; every project carries exactly one `type:` tag. Enforced by tools/workspace/check-project-boundaries.mjs in every project's `lint` target, over the real Nx project graph joined with Cargo's path dependencies. Nothing depends on the browser suite, and only the `coverage` aggregate (which merges its profiles) on the binary-driving suite, so a change to either suite never selects another project; they are selected only by changes to what they test.
